items.title: Proof of play
clues: I show that an ad appeared on a screen.
I include the screen and the time.
Advertisers want me before they pay.
items.why: Proof of play confirms an ad ran where and when it was booked.

items.title: Dwell time
clues: I am measured in seconds or minutes.
I tell how long people stay near something.
A queue at a station gives me a lot.
items.why: Dwell time is how long people spend near a screen.

items.title: Daypart
clues: I am a slice of time.
Morning commute and evening commute are examples.
I let a brand pick when to show up.
items.why: Dayparts split the day so ads can match when audiences are around.
